sections.h2: Cane area is flat nationally, and Uttar Pradesh gained the most

chart.title: Uttar Pradesh's 0.36 lakh ha gain is larger than any other state's change
chart.sub: Change in sugarcane area, kharif 2026 against kharif 2025, lakh hectares, mid-August.
chart.source: Ministry of Agriculture sowing data, via ChiniMandi.

sections.means: National cane area is 58.31 lakh hectares against 58.62 a year earlier, because Uttar Pradesh's gain of 0.36 lakh hectares outweighs the change in every other state.
sections.todo: Check the next sowing report to see whether Uttar Pradesh's gain holds, since the national total depends on it.

sections.h2: Maharashtra's sugar output rose to 99.3 lakh tonnes, from 80.26 a year earlier

chart.title: Maharashtra leads 2025-26 output, ahead of Uttar Pradesh and Karnataka
chart.sub: Sugar production by state, 2025-26 to 31 March 2026, lakh tonnes.
chart.source: Figures as given in the original post's table.

sections.means: Maharashtra's rise from 80.26 to 99.3 lakh tonnes accounts for most of the national gain of about 9 per cent to 272.31 lakh tonnes.
sections.todo: Recheck these state figures against the full-season ISMA total before using them as a final production ranking.

sections.h2: Sugar diverted to ethanol fell to 28 lakh tonnes in 2025-26, from 35 the year before

chart.title: Diversion has swung between 24 and 43 lakh tonnes, and fell again in 2025-26
chart.sub: Sugar diverted to ethanol by Ethanol Supply Year (December to November), lakh tonnes.
chart.source: Government figures as reported in the original post.

sections.means: Diversion fell from 35 to 28 lakh tonnes, still above the 24 lakh tonnes of 2023-24, when restrictions applied.
sections.todo: Watch the ESY 2026-27 diversion figure against the 2.5–3.5 million tonne range the post cites, since it tests whether the price pullback holds.

sections.h2: Spot sugar rose from ₹48.18 to ₹55.70 a kg in one month

chart.title: Spot sugar climbed within a month, the price move behind the diversion pullback
chart.sub: Spot sugar price, ₹ per kg, on two dated readings.
chart.source: Rates as quoted in the original post.

sections.means: Spot sugar rose from ₹48.18 to ₹55.70 a kg between 20 July and 20 August 2026, the period the post cites for the price spike.
sections.todo: Recheck the spot price before the 2026-27 diversion decision, because the post's October update says ex-mill prices have since fallen about 20 per cent.
